newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: La Tondena gets one bln peso loan.
newsitem.headline: La Tondena gets one bln peso loan.

text.p: Liquor firm La Tondena Distillers Inc had secured a one billion peso ($37.9 million) syndicated loan from a group of domestic financial institutions, syndicate manager All AsiaCapital and Trust Corp said on Friday.
"The loan is being used to finance the expansion project of LTDI's distillery plant in Bago, Negros Occidental," All AsiaCapital said in a statement.
La Tondena gets is supply of raw alcohol from its Negros distillery. Negros province is in central Philippines.
Aside from All AsiaCapital, other participating institutions are PDCP Development Bank, China Banking Corp, Philippine Commercial International Bank and Dharmala Capital Investment & Trust Co.
Other details of the five-year loan were not disclosed.
La Tondena is majority owned by food and beer giant San Miguel Corp.
